channel.title: mint - companies
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: 'Must make immediate, creative decisions': What CEO of 'never-ending' cruise that stranded 200 people said in his letter
item.description: More than 200 passengers, most of them Americans, were stranded in Cambodia after residential cruise operator Villa Vie Residences suspended MV Odyssey’s voyage amid soaring fuel costs linked to the US-Iran war. Founder Mikael Petterson says the company may now consider bankruptcy.

item.title: Lab Rats series: A Bengaluru startup’s bid to drug the undruggable
item.description: Backed by an ₹86 crore government grant and ₹70 crore Series A funding, Peptris Technologies is leveraging generative AI to build a preclinical pipeline targeting rare diseases and previously undruggable proteins.

item.title: Unauthorised cross-border crypto transfers: Why ED searched Mudrex and Instadapp; what is the case?
item.description: An ED investigation into alleged foreign exchange violations involving crypto transfers above ₹4,900 crore has brought Mudrex and Instadapp under scrutiny.

item.title: World’s No. 2 Gold Miner Says Diesel Risks Driving Up 2027 Costs
item.description: Agnico Eagle Mines Ltd. warned that rising diesel prices risk raising the cost of producing gold by as much as $80 per ounce next year, signaling mounting inflationary pressures for the mining industry.

item.title: Tata Group’s November test: Chandrasekaran’s reappointment row and Mehli Mistry’s November 5 hearing
item.description: Noel Tata is questioning N Chandrasekaran’s reappointment process and seeking board records. Separately, former trustee Mehli Mistry has challenged trust governance and Noel’s eligibility, while the trusts dispute his legal standing.

item.title: IndiGo CEO Willie Walsh says fare hikes unavoidable amid fuel cost surge as airline posts ₹1,879.1 crore Q2 loss
item.description: IndiGo CEO Willie Walsh said rising fuel costs will make higher airfares unavoidable and forecast low single-digit capacity growth in the December quarter. It plans to adjust aircraft deployment based on demand &amp; costs, with reductions focused more on international routes.

item.title: Whats next for law firm Weil Gotshal as it plans dissolution
item.description: WEIL-LAW FIRMS/DISSOLUTION (EXPLAINER, PIX):EXPLAINER-What's next for law firm Weil Gotshal as it plans dissolution

item.title: Nike launches first running shoes designed for India. What makes it different? Price, health benefits, top features
item.description: Nike unveiled its first-ever running shoe designed for athletes in India. The launch comes as the company continues to grapple with the dip in sales in other key regions, including China, as per Reuters.

item.title: Who is Nikhil Dhoka? Meet CEO of JioBlackRock Broking - Former Kotak Neo executive takes charge | All about him
item.description: Nikhil Dhoka has taken charge as CEO of JioBlackRock Broking after nearly four years at Kotak Neo, where he led product and revenue. His experience spans Paytm and Western Union, as the Jio Financial Services–BlackRock venture develops its digital investing business.

item.title: PNB settles ₹43 lakh in claims amid alleged fraud at Greater Noida branch
item.description: Bank says three claims have been settled as complaints mount over alleged unauthorised transfers from savings accounts and fixed deposits; 25 customers had complained by Wednesday.

item.title: Milky Mist sees limited impact from inflation, El Niño as revenue grows 42%
item.description: Milky Mist posted a strong September quarter, with revenue rising 42% and profit jumping 175%, helped by strong demand for value-added dairy products and selective price hikes. The company says inflation, El Niño and geopolitical uncertainties have had limited impact.

item.title: Ambuja Cements expects volume growth to outpace industry in H2
item.description: Trade volumes grew 8.6% in Q2FY27, but weakness in institutional sales kept overall volumes broadly flat. The company expects both segments to return to growth in the second half.

item.title: Who is Nelson Peltz? What is his net worth? US billionaire, other partners offer to buy burger chain Wendy’s for $1.4 bn
item.description: Nelson Peltz’s Trian Fund Management and partners have offered $1.4 billion, or $7.35 per share, to buy Wendy’s and take it private. The burger chain says an independent committee will review the proposal, with no guarantee of a deal.

item.title: Cognizant pips Indian peers but warns of a tech spending chill
item.description: The Nasdaq-listed information technology company's shares tumbled after it trimmed the upper end of its 2026 growth forecast, warning that healthcare and consumer-facing clients were pulling back on discretionary spending

item.title: IDBI Bank sale: Rahul Gandhi backs employees against privatisation, raises concerns over reservation and job security
item.description: The government's decision has now brought the future of IDBI Bank's ownership, employee protections and public-sector role into sharper focus, with employee representatives seeking greater transparency and parliamentary scrutiny before the sale proceeds.

item.title: IndiGo raises fares, but fuel surge keeps losses high
item.description: IndiGo’s revenue rose 26% year-on-year to ₹23,364 crore due to a hike in average yields, helping narrow its second-quarter net loss to ₹1,879 crore. However, a spike in fuel costs and softening passenger demand continue to squeeze the airline’s core operating margins.

item.title: Vedanta’s metals and oil businesses post strong Q2, steel and power lag
item.description: The company’s revenue rose 6% year-on-year to ₹2,488 crore. Profit attributable to shareholders was ₹746 crore, compared with a loss of ₹91 crore a year earlier.

item.title: AI investment boom in India: Which sectors beyond IT could benefit from data centres, power and electronics growth?
item.description: India’s AI investment boom could create opportunities beyond IT in power, data centres, electronics manufacturing and specialised industries. Axis Mutual Fund highlights the importance of sustainable earnings growth, cash flows and valuations as investors assess potential beneficiaries.

item.title: Asian Paints treads carefully on price hikes as raw material costs squeeze margins
item.description: India’s largest paint maker is wary of passing on the full impact of input cost inflation for fear of dampening demand, even as rising costs erode profitability.

item.title: Mobile connectivity startup Braid raises $38 million from Octopus Ventures; here's how it plans to use the funding
item.description: Braid has raised $38 million in its first external funding round, led by Octopus Ventures with KPN Ventures participating. Here's how it plans to use the funding.

item.title: Horizon Industrial Parks eyes strong leasing, expansion; Q2 revenue grows 30%
item.description: The Blackstone-backed firm closed 2.5 million sq ft of leasing in Q2, and turned profitable during the quarter.&nbsp;

item.title: What is Zomato's Mehmaan Mode? How a Delhi man's suggestion won Deepinder Goyal's approval
item.description: Zomato founder Deepinder Goyal has approved a LinkedIn user's suggestion for ‘Mehmaan Mode’, which would hide menu prices while guests choose food paid for by a host. The feature aims to make group orders less awkward, with users suggesting budget limits and group carts.

item.title: US accounting firm Inkle with tech ops in India acquires Finally's bookkeeping business, expands workforce — details
item.description: San Francisco-based Inkle has acquired the bookkeeping division of financial operations platform Finally in an all-cash deal, adding about 100 employees and expanding its reach across the Americas.&nbsp;

item.title: responsAbility invests $20 million in Navitas Solar as part of its Asia Climate Fund: What is it?
item.description: Navitas Solar secures $20 million or ₹190 crore from responsAbility to fund its growth plans. The investment is a part of responsAbility's Asia Climate Fund.

item.title: COTRAV BLACK to debut at AR Rahman’s Mumbai concert on November 1 with exclusive luxury experience for India’s elite
item.description: It aims to cater to business leaders, entrepreneurs, high-net-worth individuals (HNIs) and ultra-high-net-worth individuals (UHNIs) seeking exclusive access to live events, personalised hospitality and privacy.

item.title: Apple brings touchscreen to MacBook Pro after years of resistance: What's changed, and why Steve Jobs opposed it
item.description: Apple has unveiled its first touchscreen MacBook Pro, reversing years of resistance to touch-enabled laptops. Steve Jobs argued in 2010 that vertical touchscreens caused arm fatigue. Apple says advances in display technology, silicon and software have now made touch practical.

item.title: Godrej Consumer’s Q2 revenue rises 19% as pricing hikes offset cost pressures
item.description: Consolidated volume growth stood at 8% in Q2FY27 as the company raised prices across fabric care and soaps, with further increases in the pipeline.

item.title: Who is PN Vasudevan? What did he say about stepping down as Equitas Small Finance Bank CEO? Explained
item.description: Equitas Small Finance Bank board says that it had requested Vasudevan to remain in his position until a successor is identified

item.title: Trent names Bahram Vakil chairman as Noel Tata to step down after nearly three decades
item.description: The leadership transition comes as the retailer posts 22% revenue growth and 25% higher net profit in Q2, driven by store expansion and traction across its fashion brands.

item.title: New Trent Chairman: Who is Bahram Vakil? Meet Columbia University LLM holder and co-founder of AZB & Partners
item.description: Trent Ltd. appointed Bahram Vakil as chairman from November 12, replacing Noel Tata, who becomes chairman emeritus on the same day. All we know about Tata's successor.

item.title: IKEA plans a multiformat push across six markets to quadruple revenue by 2030
item.description: The Swedish retailer is banking on new stores, digital sales and business customers to accelerate growth and deepen its presence in India.

item.title: A green giant’s pollution woes: How Waaree Energies dumped toxic effluents in a Gujarat village
item.description: India’s solar poster child built a ₹1-trillion valuation on promises of a cleaner future. But along a quiet Gujarat stream, villagers point to foul runoff—and government records reveal repeated pollution notices. A Mint investigation.

item.title: CCPA fines Just Dial ₹10 lakh for listing sellers of explosive ammonium nitrate
item.description: The consumer watchdog rejected the company's defence of being a passive directory, ordering it to immediately stop facilitating access to regulated explosives without mandatory statutory disclosures.

item.title: Ahmedabad couple turns ₹3,000 into ₹6 lakh monthly business by selling cold coco from their car; here's how they did it
item.description: Darshan Zinzuvadiya is an engineer and Shruti Zinzuvadiya is an MBA in finance who launched The Coco Station with two branches in Gujarat. They serve drinks starting at ₹119.

item.title: Tata group breaking! Noel Tata to retire as Trent chairman; Bahram Vakil to take over
item.description: The company's board has appointed Bahram Vakil as chairman of Trent with effect from November 12, 2026. Noel Tata will be appointed chairman emeritus from the same date, in recognition of his contribution to the company.
